notices.title: A new version of Lunchbox is available
notices.body: You're on 0.1.1, which can't update itself on a Mac. Paste one line in Terminal and Lunchbox updates and reopens with everything as it was. After that, updates take one click.

notices.title: Lunchbox 0.1.5 is here
notices.body: Expert mode, which has your agents look at and measure their own work before handing it over. Free models you can add in one click. A savings card to share, and messages you can send while an agent works. It downloads by itself: click Restart now at the top of the window, or quit and reopen Lunchbox.
